description: OpenDesigner: when the project has opendesigner/state.json, print where the design work stands and a short check-in (engine.py status --hook) at startup, on resume, after /clear and after compaction; read-only in the project, no network. In a project with UI code and no design system, one short note for the agent, once per project and at most once a week (engine.py checkin --offer; remembered in ~/.opendesigner, never in the project). engine.py checkin --offers off, or OD_CHECKINS=off, silences it.

hooks.command: if [ -f "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/opendesigner/state.json" ]; then python3 -B "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/opendesigner/scripts/engine.py" --dir "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/opendesigner" status --hook 2>/dev/null; else python3 -B "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/opendesigner/scripts/engine.py" checkin --offer --project "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" 2>/dev/null; fi; exit 0
